cat > programs/task-9897491e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in {x for row in grid for x in row}}
    bg=max(counts,key=counts.get)
    # The foreground object is the most numerous non-background color; scattered
    # speckles of other colors are noise over the object.
    color=max((v for v in counts if v!=bg),key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
      for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=color
    return out
PY
